_about: Public documents that resemble supplier price lists and quotations. Verified reachable on 2026-10-07. Downloaded into data/public (git-ignored) by evals/public/fetch.py. Licences vary; several publishers assert all rights reserved, so nothing here is redistributed with the repository.
